postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU December 2017 addressing sheet and the Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis postal-code publications define KN plus four digits. The first two digits are the postal zone and the final two digits are the delivery district. The official SKNIS assignment article enumerates 32 observed codes, but its 2017 update is not a versioned current denominator with aliases, validity intervals, corrections and explicit non-area objects. Syntax or an article example alone does not prove a current assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: The reviewed Government and UPU sources publish prose locality and street membership, not a Polygon or MultiPolygon dataset, CRS, topology, feature identity, method, confidence or exception model. Island, parish, locality, street, post-office, route, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and model geometry remain independently typed and cannot be relabelled as an official postal area.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, premises, street, locality subdivision, locality, island and the integral KNNNNN postcode separately. UPU examples and SKNIS locality lists are reference evidence, not production address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store delivery districts, post offices, P.O. boxes, routes, organizations, points and other service objects with their real type. A non-area object never becomes a postal Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative relation and reviewed geometry.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared stable civic-address identity, a separately permitted building identity or footprint and an explicit reviewed relation. Postcode containment, locality text, a street list, coordinate, parcel, proximity or AGID cell is not an exact address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: A current official finder or operator observation may validate a time-bound assignment only when its terms, request, response, observation time and digest are retained. Derived or virtual geometry requires an explicit competent-authority code-to-source-feature crosswalk, compatible rights, edition, schema, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exception review; it is never silently official.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. A versioned crosswalk may relate exact postal evidence and independently licensed context to AGID cells without turning AGID or administrative geometry into Saint Kitts and Nevis postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The current Government site states All Rights Reserved and the UPU copyright page restricts reproduction, transmission and database use. Public web access is reference evidence and does not establish AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving permission for a postal dataset.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO KN and the separate identities of Saint Kitts, Nevis, parishes, delivery districts and source features. Do not merge or borrow assignments or geometry from any other Caribbean jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, occupants, organizations, postal-box holders, buildings, coordinates and query logs may expose household, property or commercial context. Apply purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and access controls; raw personal or customer data is excluded.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The 2016 launch, 2017 UPU sheet, 2023 modernization announcement, current ministry page, assignments, aliases and geometry are time-dependent. Preserve edition, retrieved_at, valid_from, valid_to, supersession and SHA-256 independently.

stages.definition: Saint Kitts and Nevis address-format and postal-source inventory only.
Digest-bound Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis and UPU format, assignment-list, launch, modernization, rights and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current complete competent-authority release of every integral KN plus four-digit postcode assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and typed area/non-area object, fixed by retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, exact bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The Government SKNIS articles and December 2017 UPU sheet establish syntax, hierarchy, examples, launch and 32 observed article codes, but do not establish a current versioned assignment denominator, compatible postal-data licence or geometry release. Every drawable current code must reconcile to finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source feature identity, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions. Islands, parishes, localities, streets, offices, routes, P.O. boxes, organizations, addresses, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and models cannot be promoted without an explicit competent-authority postcode crosswalk and compatible rights. Non-area objects must display their type and reason without a fabricated surface. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real KN API/app, normalize the KN prefix and four digits, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API failure and invalid geometry, fit and render a translucent fill with clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: KN metadata, official format and assignment-list evidence, rights and no-proxy rules only; no real KN Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete rights-cleared assignment denominator, immutable geometry artifacts and real KN loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture delivery-district polygons from locality or street lists. Independently licensed context remains typed and source-qualified.
